behavior: A creator makes an invoice once, with a receive address computed locally and the recipient from the profile wallet
acceptance: POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/invoices with Idempotency-Key, chainId, token, amount (decimal string) returns 201 with invoiceId (32 random bytes hex), receiveAddress, expiresAt = now + 1h unless expiresIn (15 min to 365 days, else 422), settleDeadline = expiresAt + 24h
The recipient is the profile wallet, never a request field; receiveAddress equals the Go computation of the stored terms

Same key and body -> 200 with the same invoice; same key, other body -> 409; unknown or disabled token, amount 0 or above 2^256-1 -> 422; GET /v1/invoices/{id} returns terms and statuses; api/openapi.yaml describes both routes
notes: 2026-10-09 From F046: wrap the invoice routes in requireUser(requireProfileOwner(...)) (internal/httpapi/auth.go); add PRIVY_APP_ID and PRIVY_VERIFICATION_KEY to config.LoadAPI and .env.example (until the Privy app exists, a local P-256 test key works); construct auth.NewVerifier and auth.NewService in cmd/api.

2026-10-09 review pass by reviewer: PASS. Money safety holds: receiveAddress is address.Receive over exactly the inserted values (id, profile wallet, lowercased token, canonical amount, expiresAt/settleDeadline Unix, chainId, compiled Factory/Implementation); the race path returns the stored row; recipient comes only from profile_wallets with chain_family match; buildTerms (invoice/invoice.go:109) covers every safeToSettle condition (amount!=0 via normalize, recipient != zero/receiver/factory/implementation/token). Idempotency: hash over canonical values (token case, '005'=='5', absent expiresIn == 3600), per-profile scope, constraint invoices_profile_id_idempotency_key_key proven by TestCreateLosesTheInsertRaceToTheSameKey. pnpm --filter @forwend/backend test passes; openapi.yaml lints valid with Redocly. Non-blocking: (1) chainId > 2^63-1 returns 500 and logs ERROR (pgx int8 encode fails at invoice/service.go:47); bound it to int64 -> 422, and add a maximum to openapi.yaml:99. (2) Idempotency-Key with invalid UTF-8 returns 500 (Postgres 22021); check utf8.ValidString at httpapi/invoices.go:44 -> 400. (3) amount is parsed before the digits/length check (invoice/invoice.go:72): a ~1 MB digit string costs ~0.5 s CPU per authenticated request; check len<=78 and the regex first. (4) encoding/json matches field names case-insensitively, so ChainID/Amount are accepted despite additionalProperties:false; 400 messages show Go type names (createInvoiceBody). (5) buildTerms refusal is tested only for recipient==token (httpapi/invoices_test.go:297); a table test in invoice for zero/receiver/factory/implementation would pin all cases; service_test.go covers only the race. (6) Proof line 3 credits docs-check with Redocly lint, but scripts/check-docs.py does not lint the spec.
